data.title: Keep accepted audio capture permission alive during device startup
data.body: Fix a user-observed audio reconnect failure after an exact audio capture request was accepted promptly but cold getUserMedia completed after the5-second arm deadline. Keep a5-second window for fresh intent; once the one exact sender/audio-only request is admitted, let that in-flight attempt settle without expiring its grant. Preserve one-attempt admission, exact sender/page checks, token matching, cancel/revoke/navigation/destruction cleanup and no extra device permissions. Add bounded local phase/timing diagnostics without tokens or device IDs. Acceptance: deferred accepted request activates after deadline; unconsumed stale arms and foreign/duplicate/cancelled requests remain rejected; security review and focused permission/runtime tests pass. Main owns any install/restart and live demonstration.
data.summary:
Fixed audio capture activation while preserving bounded permission intent. Fresh arms remain5seconds; one admitted exact audio-only request has60seconds to settle. Armed/new-capture checks cannot bypass exact request admission; duplicate, foreign, expired, cancelled or revoked activation remains rejected. Added local phase and elapsed/attempt diagnostics without device identity or tokens.
Independently reviewed; real CABLE capture validated by coordinator. Reviewed product sequence integrated into actual main31c13ef6daf7a4b5e3ac67c7c676e66034f70d3e. User dirty Claude checkout preserved; no remote operations. Main branch left free for checkout.
